purpose: Inspect observed completed-drive arrival battery percentages, contextual profiles, evidence support and row accounting in the selected vehicle-local history window.
primaryGoal: Understand historical arrival buffer and the descriptive effect of a planning threshold without mistaking capped observational evidence for future range prediction.

Mount-frozen nowMs, validated completed arrivals, exclusion accounting, interpolated percentiles, strict thresholds, ten histogram bands, latest 24 local months, seven weekdays, six four-hour buckets, five SI distance bands, supported destinations capped at 12, ten lowest arrivals, evidence breadth/recency support. No prediction or additional server aggregate.

issues.detail: empty=false is unconditional and data={rows} is supplied outside SectionBody. The histogram produces ten zero-count buckets even without resolved/included evidence; ChartContainer fallback table is derived independently of the domain body. Assistive fallback can therefore expose synthetic zero rows beside a no-vehicle/error/empty explanation.
issues.fix: Gate source-backed chart/fallback rows on resolved qualified evidence while keeping section shells, explicit empty explanations and genuine zero counts in populated buckets. Apply the same trust gating to fixed weekday/hour/distance/threshold arrays.

visualIssues.detail: Arrival values use fixed text-rose-300/text-amber-300/text-emerald-300 with no light-theme counterpart. Methodology.tsx:141,161 and directory.tsx:190 also hard-code cyan-300 for decorative emphasis. These are toned-down rather than neon, but theme-effective contrast is unknown.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse semantic severity/theme text tokens or established light/dark pairs. Neutralize decorative icons; preserve numeric threshold meaning and textual values. Measure real light/dark backgrounds.

visualIssues.detail: Each percentile profile uses indexed purple/count plus rose/p10, blue/median, amber/p90 and optional sixth-color context. Sensitivity also uses palette positions to represent selected threshold. These are existing shared palettes, not proven visual failures, but repeat multi-hue emphasis without explicit palette semantics.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing chart palette owner to distinguish ordinal percentile series by restrained hue/line weight/dash and count opacity; reserve danger/warning hues for real threshold meaning. Preserve saved palette choices and every series.

visualIssues.detail: Retained refresh failure can show both page StaleRefreshWarning and QueryStatus warning/retry, plus retained badges on four briefs. This can repeat the same warning above a dense 13-section page.
visualIssues.fix: Coordinate the existing feedback owners to present one primary recovery action and retain local trust indicators without duplicated long banners. Preserve both error semantics and cached evidence.

architectureIssues.detail: All four embedded percentile profiles use chartKey=range-buffer-percentile. The embedded context state takes precedence over the unique outer profile hiddenSeries at line 86. Source wiring gives four mounted charts a common legend persistence identity instead of their distinct outer keys.
architectureIssues.fix: Use one hidden-series provider per profile or pass its existing outer chart key through the domain renderer; retain existing keys and correct persisted/URL behavior rather than introducing another store.

architectureIssues.detail: Analysis slices supported destination profiles to 12 (rangeBuffer.ts:666) and records omittedSupportedDestinations, but directory disclosure only reports supported/locatable totals. A reader cannot see how many supported destinations were omitted from the displayed directory.
architectureIssues.fix: Display the existing displayed/omitted destination coverage counts without changing grouping, cap, sorting or backend scope.

sections.name: Arrival buffer by local completion time

actions: Workspace vehicle/range changes; do not duplicate these selectors.
Planning threshold Select: 10/15/20/25/30/40%, default 20, in-memory state; recomputes local evidence.
Fatal/refresh retry refetches the same drives query.
Four OperationalBrief Review details actions and drawer closure via shared owner; drawer internals not inspected.
Chart legend series toggles in monthly/weekday/hour/distance/threshold charts; preserve current source-backed identities.
Six chart export menus support PNG/SVG/copy-image and CSV through existing ChartContainer; enabled only with relevant resolved evidence by callers.
Destination value filters, sample sorting and pagination; lowest-arrivals arrival sorting; table persistence IDs must survive. Further DataTable capabilities are unverified.
dataBehavior: One bounded drives source, maximum 1000 rows, server-bound selected vehicle/start/end; cap warning never claims lifetime completeness.
Frozen mount clock rejects later completions; preserve intentionally frozen analysis semantics.
Every row enters exactly one primary category: included/incomplete/invalid time-order/future/invalid arrival.
End SoC finite 0-100 is required; secondary start/distance/destination fields never decide arrival inclusion.
Increasing SoC rows excluded only from depletion; missing percentiles/distance remain null, not zero.
Linear interpolated drive-weighted percentiles rounded in model; selected threshold comparison is strict less-than.
Destination address normalization, rounded 3-decimal coordinate fallback, minimum 3 arrivals, sample-count/name ordering, top-12 cap.
Latest 24 months, all weekdays/four-hour categories and fixed meter bands; missing categories retain null percentile evidence.
Lowest 10 sort by arrival SoC then newest completion and original source order.
Support weights .35/.25/.25/.15 with volume/day/week targets 50/20/8 and tiered recency; support is not predictive confidence.
Timezone, locale, precision, saved units, display-only SI conversion, query keys/cancellation and retained-data recovery remain intact.
Methodology preserves eight definitions plus future-range caution; do not hide any content for mobile.
